exposure: Preconception inoculation with an inactivated SARS-CoV-2 vaccine (BBIBP-CorV)
cohort: The study included 913 mother-infant pairs from pregnant and postpartum women who delivered between January and May 2023 at You'ai Hospital and the Maternal and Child Health Hospital in Urumqi.
finding: Prepregnancy BBIBP-CorV vaccination was not associated with an increased risk of adverse neonatal outcomes in any vaccinated group compared to unvaccinated groups.
